scope: Method-explicit reporting of takeoff-to-apex rise (H2) for the V3 20 kg loaded CMJ. This panel separates heterogeneous measurement methods and refuses to convert them into one elite target.

h2_authority.origin_event: RES-84 TAKEOFF_OCCURRENCE (last ACTIVE legal plantar sample -> first zero active legal plantar sample; contact-force extrapolated timestamp)
h2_authority.apex_definition: first SYSTEM_COM vertical-velocity + -> non-positive crossing strictly inside confirmed genuine flight
hard_gate_withheld_reason: no force-plate or bar/LVT study on file measures the same quantity as the direct simulator SYSTEM_COM span between the RES-84 occurrence and the in-flight apex crossing
the human literature reports takeoff-to-apex or standing-to-apex flight-time and impulse-derived heights whose definitions differ from the simulator quantity
no conversion with bounded uncertainty between SYSTEM_COM truth, force-plate impulse-momentum, flight-time and bar/LVT families has been established or calibrated for this Plant

h_anti_triviality_floor.closure_rule: H2 >= H_ANTI_TRIVIALITY_FLOOR is a minimum functional success condition for this task; a physically valid causal takeoff and flight below the floor is classified BELOW_FUNCTIONAL_TASK_FLOOR and cannot close the task
explicit_statements: 0.150 m is NOT an elite-performance norm
0.150 m is NOT an optimization target
0.150 m IS a minimum functional success condition
controller development seeks the best physically valid solution under the frozen constraints, not the floor

diagnostic_scale_cross_check.rule: minimum ballistic vz corresponding to 0.150 m = sqrt(2*g*0.150) ~= 1.716 m/s
diagnostic_scale_cross_check.use: mechanics cross-check only; direct SYSTEM_COM H2 is never replaced by a ballistic estimate

permitted_uses: hard functional non-triviality boundary for task closure
named negative-control magnitude in deterministic checks
mechanics cross-check scale for the minimum ballistic takeoff velocity

forbidden: bare 'jump height' label without a method qualifier

methods.definition: SYSTEM_COM_z(apex) - SYSTEM_COM_z(TAKEOFF_OCCURRENCE), both read from the sealed-V3 SYSTEM_COM state at the RES-84 event timestamps; apex inside confirmed genuine flight; ballistic cross-check vz(occurrence)^2/(2g) is reported separately
methods.cross_check_role: BALLISTIC_HEIGHT_FROM_TAKEOFF_VZ is a physics consistency residual, not an independent performance gate
methods.processing_sensitivity: none: no force threshold, no integration, no flight-time assumption participates in the span
evidence: RES-82 PERFORMANCE_METRIC_CONTRACT quantity A (in-repo, structurally frozen)

methods.definition: vertical impulse of (Fz - m g) over the takeoff interval, divided by system mass; on the simulator this is the discrete LEFT_RECTANGLE_INTEGRATOR_CONSISTENT cross-check of SYSTEM_COM vertical velocity
known_biases: requires a force threshold to bound the takeoff interval; the 10 N comparator is a diagnostic convention, not physical takeoff
yields the takeoff-to-apex family only under a point-mass assumption at apex
evidence: RES-82 PERFORMANCE_METRIC_CONTRACT quantities B and E (in-repo)

methods.definition: g * T_flight^2 / 8 with both flight boundaries taken from force-threshold crossings
known_biases: assumes equal COM height at takeoff and landing (violated by loaded landing absorption)
boundary choice moves the flight interval by up to the comparator dwell
bias-class relative to model truth is uncalibrated on this Plant
evidence: Eythorsdottir 2024 PMID 39425876 (four height equations, up to ~15 cm divergence)

methods.units: m (displacement) or m/s (velocity) with derived height
methods.definition: linear position/velocity transducer on the bar or tether: peak positive displacement, or velocity-derived height h = v^2/(2g), or displacement/velocity-based jump height
known_biases: measures the bar/handle path, not the SYSTEM_COM; the two diverge by segment motion and bar-path curvature
systematic overestimation of jump height versus force plate and motion capture (reported mean differences ~7.0-8.7 cm in CMJ/SJ)
velocity estimates from LPT/LVT show questionable concurrent validity; peak values are preferred over mean values
attachment site and device family change the bias; cross-device comparison is not advised
the simulator has no bar tether instrument, so this family cannot be produced natively here
evidence: Wadhi 2018 PMID 30572577 Sports (Basel) 6(4):177 (GymAware LPT overestimation, CMJ MD 8.68 +/- 2.99 cm)
O'Donnell 2018 Meas Phys Educ Exerc Sci 22(1):101-107 (LPT overestimation 7.0 +/- 2.8 cm)
Hojka 2022 Biol Sport 39(2):341-348 (attachment-site bias; recalculation needed before cross-device comparison)
Sports Biomech 2024;23(10) systematic review (LVT/LPT validity split by exercise; peak values recommended)
Suchomel 2023 PMC10055813 (device-family disagreement in barbell velocity)

requirements_for_any_future_conversion: an explicit, named conversion model between the two method families
a bounded, method-matched uncertainty quantified on this Plant or on a matched human protocol
a registered acceptance test that fails closed when the conversion is applied outside its validated domain
an owner decision recorded in the experiment registry
conversion_policy.reporting_rule: Every reported rise carries its method qualifier; heterogeneous family values may be displayed side by side but never pooled, averaged or reconciled into one number

must_report: the H_ANTI_TRIVIALITY_FLOOR classification of the episode (ABOVE_FLOOR or BELOW_FUNCTIONAL_TASK_FLOOR)
BALLISTIC_HEIGHT_FROM_TAKEOFF_VZ and its residual vs the primary (consistency)
IMPULSE_DERIVED_TAKEOFF_VELOCITY and its velocity residual vs occurrence SYSTEM_COM vz (cross-check)
FLIGHT_TIME_HEIGHT from the diagnostic comparator boundaries (report-only, if evaluable)
bar/LVT family: NOT_APPLICABLE_NATIVE (no tether instrument exists on this Plant), stated explicitly
must_not: declare an elite loaded-CMJ performance claim from any H2 value
present H_ANTI_TRIVIALITY_FLOOR as an elite norm, expected value, target band or population claim
close the task with an H2 below H_ANTI_TRIVIALITY_FLOOR
